name: Deniz Yilmaz
bio:
Deniz's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at Istanbul Technical University, specializing in vehicle dynamics and simulation. After graduating, he honed his skills at a local sim racing center, developing advanced setups and providing feedback to aspiring drivers. His expertise in simulator technology and data analysis caught the attention of 23XI Racing, where he now plays a crucial role in optimizing vehicle performance and driver training.

Deniz's approach to simulator engineering is deeply rooted in data-driven decision-making. He meticulously analyzes telemetry data, correlating it with driver feedback to identify areas for improvement. His ability to translate complex data into actionable insights has made him a valuable asset to the team. What sets Deniz apart is his relentless pursuit of innovation, constantly exploring new simulation techniques and technologies to push the boundaries of what's possible.

He is known for his collaborative spirit and his ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear and concise manner. Deniz is driven by a desire to contribute to the team's success and to help drivers reach their full potential. His ultimate goal is to develop simulation tools that accurately reflect the real-world performance of the race car, enabling the team to gain a competitive edge.
